verdict.rationale: Sardine's own docs say async business-verification (KYB) updates are delivered as webhook events, so the product does emit outbound webhooks. The evidence is a single passing mention scoped to one feature, with no documentation of how to register endpoints or which event types exist. missing for 10: documented webhook endpoint registration/subscription flow, event catalog across products (e.g., transaction, sanctions, monitoring alerts), payload/signature/retry details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Business verification updates require listening to async webhook events.
